:::{#def-optimization-algorithm}
#### Optimization algorithm

Let:

- $f : \reals^p \to \reals$: an [objective function](#def-objective-function);
- $F \subseteq \reals^p$: a [feasible set](#def-feasible-set).

An **optimization algorithm**
[@wikipedia_mathematical_optimization]
is a step-by-step procedure that [maps](functions.qmd#def-function) the pair $(f, F)$ to a feasible point $\vx^\dagger$:

$$
(f, F) \mapsto \vx^\dagger \in F.
$$ {#eq-optimization-algorithm}

In words:
given $(f, F)$,
the procedure returns a feasible point $\vx^\dagger$ intended to make $f(\vx^\dagger)$ small.

:::
